svg.title: Ila asks Riju what the missing two per cent contains.
svg.desc: A narrow unfilled wedge separates Ila from Riju. Ila points her spectacles towards it while Riju holds the private anomaly file against his satchel and says the cases only need more time.
svg.text: Page 32, panel 4 · Still medium shot of Ila beside the almost-complete score

text.tspan: Ila asks what the missing fraction represents, and
Riju treats it as overnight cleanup.
